    Before you continue: personal data processing

    We use cookies on our websites to provide you with the best possible experience. This includes data processing that helps our websites run smoothly, as well as other techniques which ensure the content you are seeing is relevant to you. We may transfer your personal data to third party companies outside the UK, but only under strict contract and with adequate safeguards in place for the protection of your data. You can either click 'Accept' to accept all cookies, or select in 'Customise' which cookies you would like to allow. By selecting 'Reject' you only allow the use of technically necessary cookies. Further information including your right to withdraw consent at any time, can be found in our privacy policy. Our general legal information can be found here.

    Specify the scope of consent

    You can personalise your preferences according to the options below. You can either click 'Accept all' to accept all cookies, or select in 'Allow selection' which cookies you would like to allow. By accepting 'Decline all' you only allow the use of technically necessary cookies. If you expand the sections below you will find detailed information on the cookies and data processing involved. Further information including your right to withdraw consent at any time can be found in our privacy policy.

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Necessary

    Always Active

    These are cookies and similar methods without which you cannot use our services (e.g. for the correct display of our website/functions requested by you, to save your registration in the login area, etc.).

    Preferences

    These techniques allow us to take into account your actual or perceived preferences for the comfortable use of our websites. For example, we can use your preferences to display our websites in a language that suits you. It also helps us avoid showing you products that may not be available in your region.

    Statistics

    These techniques enable us to compile pseudonymous statistics on the use of our services for the purpose of tailoring them to our needs. This enables us, for example, to determine how we can adapt our websites even better to the habits of the users.

    Marketing

    This enables us and other responsible parties to show you suitable advertising content based on the analysis of your pseudonymous usage behaviour. Your usage behaviour can also be tracked across different websites, browsers or end devices using a user ID (unique identifier).
